text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both in retreat, down roughly 2-2.5% over 24 hours, while smaller caps like Solana show relative resilience, suggesting risk-off positioning among retail and institutional traders. The Fear & Greed index sits at extreme fear with no improvement over a week, indicating sustained seller pressure and low conviction to buy dips. Bitcoin dominance holding at 57.7% combined with modest total volume of $73B points to cautious capital preservation rather than panic liquidation—a defensive posture typical of consolidation phases before directional clarity returns.
